annotations.title: Is this service up, and what does it serve?

description: Liveness and the whole tool inventory for every MCP endpoint at referencesource.org, in one call: each endpoint's URL, whether it is answering right now, its protocol revisions, its tools, and the record count and last-verified date of the register behind it. Built for a directory, an index or a liveness check refreshing its entry — you do not need to connect to each endpoint or call a tool to find out that we are up and what we have. The same document is a plain keyless GET at https://referencesource.org/mcp/status.json (also https://referencesource.org/mcp/status), which costs you one request instead of a handshake, and is the better way to poll. Takes no arguments. Nothing here reads a register's data, so it is not an answer about a record: for that, call list_datasets or search_records.
name: server_status

endpoints.description: One block per endpoint: path, url, live, checked (the methods it was sent), name, version, protocol_revisions, tools, and the register figures where it has one.

status.description: "ok" when every endpoint answered, "degraded" when one did not.
